description: Two notes from the same week disagree on how often the patient takes her medication.
input_notes: Psychiatry note: Continue Sertraline 100 mg oral once daily in the morning; well tolerated.
Primary care note (same week): Patient states she takes her Sertraline 100 mg twice a day, once in the morning and once in the evening.

possible_inconsistencies: Sertraline frequency differs between the psychiatry note (once daily) and the primary care note (twice a day) from the same week.
expected.summary: Sertraline dose is consistent at 100 mg, but the documented frequency differs between psychiatry (once daily) and primary care (twice daily) in the same week.
